combo1.title: Theorealized Medius: Nerva, Diactorus and an Impasto Hand-off
combo1.description: Going first with an Artmage build. Artmage Power Patron is the Power Patron card that lets Theorealized Medius Special Summon itself from the hand, and the Theorealize Liberation it adds calls Nervedo for Nerva. You pass with Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Artmage Graflare and Theorealized Medius (Illusion, Fairy and Dragon: three Monster Types) plus a set Artmage Impasto -Recapture-. On your opponent's turn, Impasto banishes Artmage Diactorus face-up until the End Phase. That banish triggers Theorealized Medius, which brings out a second Artmage Diactorus while the first is away. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius. Extra Deck: Nerva the Power Patron of Creation and 2 Artmage Diactorus.

cards.name: Nerva the Power Patron of Creation

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon Artmage Power Patron from your Deck. Its name makes it a Power Patron monster, so there is now a Power Patron card on the field.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius in your hand. Artmage Power Patron is the Power Patron card it needs. Medius the Pure isn't one.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your hand.
Add Theorealize Liberation from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Liberation. You control Medius the Pure, the card it names. Theorealized Medius alone wouldn't meet the condition.
Theorealize Liberation resolves: Special Summon Nervedo the Shadebeast Power Patron from your Deck. It has 300 ATK and 200 DEF.
Theorealize Liberation goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Nervedo, banishing the top 3 cards of your Deck face-down as the cost. Face-down banishes don't trigger Theorealized Medius.
Nervedo is destroyed. It's a Pendulum Monster, so it goes to your Extra Deck face-up.
Special Summon Nerva the Power Patron of Creation from your Extra Deck. This is treated as a Fusion Summon, which Artmage Power Patron's restriction allows.
Activate effect: Nervedo was added to your Extra Deck face-up.
Special Summon Artmage Graflare from your Deck.
Activate effect: Artmage Power Patron (Quick Effect).
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as material.
Send Artmage Power Patron to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Artmage Diactorus.
Activate effect: Artmage Power Patron was sent from the field to the GY.
Add Artmage Impasto -Recapture- from your Deck to your hand. There's no card with that name in your GY.

Set Artmage Impasto -Recapture- and end your turn. Nerva, Artmage Diactorus, Theorealized Medius and Graflare cover three Monster Types, so Diactorus's negation and Graflare's Quick Effect are both live.
Your opponent's turn. They activate a monster effect: activate Artmage Impasto -Recapture-.

Banish Artmage Diactorus until the End Phase. The activation is negated and that monster is destroyed. Nerva, Theorealized Medius and Graflare are still three Monster Types, so their Spells and Traps also return to the hand.
Artmage Impasto -Recapture- goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius. A monster was just banished face-up.
Banish Theorealized Medius.
Special Summon the second Artmage Diactorus from your Extra Deck. With Nerva and Graflare it still makes three Monster Types, so its negation is live again this turn.
End Phase: the first Artmage Diactorus returns to the field. You now have two.

combo2.title: Theorealized Medius: DoomZ Break - Diactorus Clears the Way
combo2.description: Going second with the Ars Magna package. Theorealized Medius skips the first Ars Magna banish and waits for the second, once Ars Magna "Citrinitas" is face-up. Citrinitas is always treated as a DoomZ card, which gives the DoomZ Break - Diactorus it calls from the Extra Deck a DoomZ card to destroy before it destroys a monster. That summon also brings back the Corruption and the Purification, and the Purification Power Patron Link Summon returns the Division and the Union. From two cards you destroy one monster, banish another monster and a Spell/Trap, and draw 1. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification.

cards.name: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification
Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite
Ars Magna the Division and the Union

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your Deck. It is always treated as a Power Patron card, so Medius can call it.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification from your hand.
Add Ars Magna "Citrinitas" from your Deck to your hand. Theorealized Medius could activate for this banish, but let it pass. Its effect works once per turn, and the next banish is worth more.
Activate Ars Magna "Citrinitas". It is always treated as an Artmage, DoomZ and Elfnote card.
Activate effect: Ars Magna "Citrinitas". It can do this once while it stays face-up.
Add Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite from your hand.
Add Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your Deck to your hand. It isn't a Warrior, so the Finite and the Infinite can add it.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius. A monster was just banished face-up.
Banish Theorealized Medius.
Special Summon DoomZ Break - Diactorus from your Extra Deck. It's a Rank 4 Xyz Monster, but it arrives with no materials.
Activate effect: DoomZ Break - Diactorus was Special Summoned.
Activate effect in the same chain: an Xyz Monster was just Special Summoned while the Corruption and the Purification was banished, so it Special Summons itself.
DoomZ Break - Diactorus resolves: destroy Ars Magna "Citrinitas". It counts as a DoomZ card on your field, and its search is already used.
Then destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
Activate effect: banish Ars Magna the Division and the Union from your hand.
Special Summon the Finite and the Infinite from banishment. The Division and the Union can bring back any non-Spellcaster Ars Magna monster.
Send Medius the Pure to the GY as material.
Send DoomZ Break - Diactorus to the GY as material.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone. Its search needs a Power Patron monster in your GY, and Theorealized Medius is banished, so it doesn't add anything.
Activate effect: a Link Monster was just Special Summoned while the Division and the Union was banished, so it Special Summons itself.
Activate effect: Ars Magna the Finite and the Infinite. You control a Power Patron Link Monster, so target 1 monster on the field and banish it.
Activate effect: Ars Magna the Corruption and the Purification. You control 1 Power Patron Link Monster, so target 1 Spell/Trap on the field and banish it.
Activate effect: Ars Magna the Division and the Union.
Banish Ars Magna "Citrinitas" from your GY as the cost, then draw 1 card.
Result: one monster destroyed, another monster and a Spell/Trap banished, and 1 card drawn. Purification Power Patron is still on the field for the next play.

combo3.title: Theorealized Medius: Theorealize, a Self-Banish and Past Lull
combo3.description: A Medius build with two copies of Theorealized Medius and no Artmage cards in the Main Deck. Medius the Pure calls one copy from the Deck, and that copy is the Power Patron card the one in your hand needs. Theorealize sends a second Medius the Pure to the GY. That copy revives itself and is banished when it leaves the field, and the face-up banish triggers Theorealized Medius. The same Link Summon puts the other copy in the GY, which is what Purification Power Patron's search needs. You end on Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and a Medius the Pure your opponent couldn't respond to. Starting hand: Medius the Pure + Theorealized Medius.

steps.text: Normal Summon Medius the Pure.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure was Normal Summoned.
Special Summon a second Theorealized Medius from your Deck. It is always treated as a Power Patron card.
Activate effect: Theorealized Medius in your hand. The copy on the field is a Power Patron card, and no copy has used this effect this turn.
Special Summon Theorealized Medius from your hand.
Add Theorealize from your Deck to your hand. Its name makes it a Theorealize Spell.
Activate Theorealize.
Send a second Medius the Pure from your Deck to the GY as the cost.
Theorealize resolves: look at the top card of your opponent's Deck and put it on the top or the bottom. Theorealize goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Medius the Pure in your GY. The first copy only used its summon effect, so this effect is still free.
Shuffle the first Medius the Pure from the field into your Deck. Past Lull will summon it again at the end.
Special Summon Medius the Pure from your GY. It will be banished when it leaves the field.
Send the Theorealized Medius that came from the Deck to the GY as material.
Use Medius the Pure as material too. It was summoned by its own effect, so it's banished face-up instead of going to the GY.
Link Summon Purification Power Patron to the left Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Purification Power Patron's summon trigger. The Theorealized Medius in your GY is a Power Patron monster.
In the same chain, activate effect: the Theorealized Medius still on the field. Medius the Pure was just banished face-up.
Theorealized Medius resolves first: banish it.
Special Summon Artmage Diactorus from your Extra Deck, into the zone below Purification Power Patron.
Purification Power Patron resolves: add Theorealize Past Lull from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Theorealize Past Lull. Artmage Diactorus is an Artmage card, so its condition is met.
Theorealize Past Lull resolves: Special Summon Medius the Pure from your Deck. Your opponent can't respond to the summon. Its summon effect was already used this turn.
Theorealize Past Lull goes to the GY.

End board: Purification Power Patron, Artmage Diactorus and Medius the Pure. Medius is the other DARK Fairy that keeps Purification's Quick Effect live on your opponent's turn, and Past Lull's GY effect is ready for next turn.
